Efficient finish desk rules for waiting areas
This page teaches what is expected

At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, we help travelers and their animals move through the airport with calm, clear support. This matters because pets and owners often arrive anxious, and a steady desk experience builds trust in Aurelia Skyways from the first greeting to the final handoff.

Speak in a warm, even tone, and keep your instructions simple. Check the travel record, confirm the animal's basics, and make sure the carrier or crate meets desk standards before you send anyone onward. If a traveler needs a change to the booking, record it in the desk ledger right away so the next team sees the same details. Clear notes prevent confusion at the gate and help protect the animal's comfort.

When a traveler arrives with a dog or bird, give the required guidance without delay and stay within the approved process for each species. <<FACT F057>> Keep your language direct and kind so the traveler knows what to do next. If the desk line is busy, triage in order of arrival and let people know we are working through each case carefully.

For birds, also check the carrier handling steps with care. <<FACT F065>> Make sure the crate is secure, the air flow is clear, and the passenger understands how the animal will be moved. Use the ledger to note any special service change, and alert the senior coordinator if the case needs extra review. If you see a concern with behavior, comfort, or documentation, pause the process and ask for guidance rather than guessing.

Remember to keep the waiting area calm, protect privacy, and give each traveler steady, respectful help from start to finish.
